extension.description: Fullscreen idle player for JellyFlam3 catalog loops from Jellyfin (Static MP4). When the server or flock is unavailable, shows a short on-screen hint on black — no bundled test pattern. Kodi video screensaver — separate from the Roku stills package. Does not render flam3 locally. Client name JellyFlam3-Screensaver is ignored by the furnace idle-gate.
extension.news: 0.2.6 - Always expand Jellyfin by-generation folders (partial flat ParentId flock).
